fields.title: Narrate reads 1000–1099 as years too, and keeps comma numbers as counts
fields.description: A `preNormalize` step in `main/narrate/normalize.js`, applied before `tts.generate` in `main/narrate/capture.js` and inside `spokenWordsOf`, reads 1001–1099 in kokoro's year form. Comma numbers stay counts, and the producer's word mapping stays exact.
